conceptual_change: Instead of relying on simple liquidity sweeps or price-level identification, this hypothesis measures the expansion of volatility (range_ratio) relative to anomalous volume spikes (volume_ratio) to detect institutional liquidity voids (FVGs) before consolidation.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
